description: Generated Parameter Options plugin for the node_size parameter. Starts from a customer-editable ALLOWED_NODE_SIZES allow-list (bucketed arm/amd/x64), resolves the selected OS Build's Azure VM image via the chosen Environment, classifies its processor architecture, and returns only the allowed sizes for that architecture. Attach to the node_size custom field via Parameter > Options > Generated, and wire os_build as a REGENOPTIONS controller of node_size.
name: Node Size - Generate Options by OS Build Architecture
